description: Lu Bu, towering chinese warrior in the supplied pixel art style, riding a red-brown war horse. Two long red pheasant feathers rising from a gold crown, black and red armor with gold trim, a long red cape. Red-brown horse with red and gold tack. He holds a very long halberd with a spear point and twin crescent side blades in the right hand
face: Proud fierce young eyes, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the two long red feathers, black hair, the long red cape hanging over the horse's rump, the horse's tail between its hind legs.
guard_action: the rider brings the weapon from upright to a ready angle; the horse stands still on four legs

actions.idle: Mounted fighting guard, horse standing still on four legs, breathing
actions.move: Seamless gallop in place, rider carrying the weapon, no attack. The four legs follow the skeleton. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Mounted THRUST. Frames 3-5 the pole is laid level beside the right hip and drawn back; frame 8 it is driven straight forward, point first; frames 9-11 hold the reach. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The halberd stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time. Rider stays seated in the saddle, four horse legs always present.
actions.b2: Two mounted cuts. Frames 1-5 wind up; frame 6 the first cut down; frames 7-9 a half lift; frame 10 the second cut; frames 11-12 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The halberd stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time. Rider stays seated in the saddle, four horse legs always present.
actions.a3: Mounted HORIZONTAL sweeping cut, held near the butt end. Frames 3-5 the blade is swung far out to the right and back, level; frames 6-8 it sweeps around from the side to the front in a wide flat arc; frames 9-11 hold in front. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The halberd stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time. Rider stays seated in the saddle, four horse legs always present.
actions.s3: Peerless sweep. Frames 1-6 the weapon is drawn far out behind on the right, the horse braced low; frame 8 hips, chest and shoulders unwind in turn and it sweeps wide from outside to the front; frames 9-12 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The halberd stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time. Rider stays seated in the saddle, four horse legs always present.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → b2 → a3, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 원화의 무기가 본보다 훨씬 길어(약 170~200px) 캔버스에 안 들어간다. weapon_mode slide: 무기 끝은 본의 위치 그대로, 남는 길이는 손 뒤로 보낸다. 공격 중에는 손이 자루 가운데쯤을 잡고, 대기에서는 원화의 그립으로 돌아온다.
